general1.event: If only your body hadn't given up on you- c_n is being run horribly, and you know you could be doing so much better.

general2.event: You watch over the cats in the Dark Forest with narrowed eyes, silently observing from high above.

general3.event: c_n would be doing so much better with you as the Leader.

general4.event: You wonder if StarClan regrets gifting you nine lives.
